text:
Hana V.: Heads-up: were pushing a docs + tooling announcement about stricter response-schema enforcement on the generation APIs in the next SDK release. This changes the default behavior for free-form responses -> structured JSON. :information_source:
Owen R.: quick TL;DR of the breaking part?
Hana V.: Previously the SDK tried to guess/deserialize free-form responses into Python/JS objects when users supplied a loose `format` param. In the new SDK well require an explicit `response_schema` (JSON Schema) or `parse_mode='raw'`. Calls that depended on implicit parsing will get a validation error unless you opt into compat mode.
Priya R.: what are the immediate options for teams that want zero-change?
Hana V.: Two short-term options: 1) pin to the last pre-enforcement SDK patch (example below), or 2) enable `schema_compat` shim which restores legacy permissive parsing for a short window. The docs announce includes checklist and a small compat package.

```
# python requirements.txt
redwood-sdk==3.20.1

# node package.json
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/inference": "3.20.1"
}
```

Hana V.: Example shim usage (Python):

```
from redwood_schema_compat import CompatParser
client = CompatParser(api_key=...)
# client will accept legacy responses and attempt to map them to old shapes
```

docs-bot: Schema enforcement guide + compat shim: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/response-schema-enforcement (includes codemod, CI checks, and canary plan)
Marta B.: are there helper tools for authors who use ad-hoc parsing in many places?
Hana V.: Yes  we shipped a codemod `rw-extract-schema` that runs in dry-run to suggest JSON schemas for many common prompt/response pairs, and a `rw-schema-verify` CLI that runs as part of CI to fail on schema drift. Usage examples in the guide.
Owen R.: CI snippet?
Hana V.: Example GH Action: `pip install rw-schema-tools && rw-schema-verify --dir=services/api --fail-on-mismatch`. We also included a pytest plugin `pytest-rw-schema` to validate recorded examples during test runs.
Priya R.: timeline and sunset details?
Hana V.: Deprecation notice out today. Enforcement will be opt-in for 2 weeks after GA for hosted customers, then default-on in 4 weeks. The `schema_compat` shim will be supported for 120 days after GA for internal teams; hosted Dedicated/Private customers must enable the env flag or deploy the compat package themselves. Exact dates are in the guide.
Marta B.: telemetry/impact measurement?
Hana V.: We added an opt-in fingerprint that captures response-shape hashes (no content) so teams can estimate how many endpoints will break. The playbook includes SQL queries to run against our usage logs (opt-in) and a small evaluation prompt set you can run locally to measure parity.
Owen R.: customer-facing docs and migration notes?
Hana V.: PMs should follow the checklist: 1) identify generate callsites 2) add explicit `response_schema` or `parse_mode='raw'` 3) add schema-verify to CI 4) run codemod and review suggested schemas 5) schedule canary. Docs include email/KB copy for customer comms.
Priya R.: who to ping if we discover a regression during rollout?
Hana V.: Ping me (@hana) or Priya on #eng-runtime and open an issue with label `sdk-schema`. We can enable an emergency compat gate for hosted traffic if needed.
Marta B.: small example of explicit schema usage?
Hana V.: Python/Node examples below.

```
# python example
schema = {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string"},
    "score": {"type": "number"}
  },
  "required": ["title"]
}
resp = client.generate(prompt, response_schema=schema)
# resp.parsed -> {'title': '...', 'score': 0.93}

# node example
const schema = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: { title: { type: 'string' }, score: { type: 'number' } },
  required: ['title']
}
const resp = await client.generate(prompt, { response_schema: schema })
// resp.parsed => { title: '...', score: 0.93 }
```

docs-bot: Migration guide, codemod, and CI recipes: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/response-schema-enforcement#migration
Owen R.: anything special for logs / observability teams?
Hana V.: Add schema identifiers to traces for easier debugging (`schema_id` header). We added a tracing cookbook for correlating parse failures with request IDs. Also added a lightweight dashboard in Console to show schema validation failures over time per service.
Priya R.: final TL;DR?
Hana V.: 1) New SDK requires explicit response schema or parse_mode 'raw' 2) If you need no change: pin to 3.20.1 or enable schema_compat shim 3) Run `rw-extract-schema` and `rw-schema-verify` in CI 4) Opt-in telemetry + tracing helpers available 5) Ping #eng-runtime with label `sdk-schema` for emergencies.
Marta B.: thanks 44d Ill schedule the codemod run on our repo and add schema-verify to CI this week.
docs-bot: Docs PR + tools release scheduled for tomorrow morning UTC.
